items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So every day for the remaining three days he was there, he would give me two or three hours of the fundamentals, and then I would take him between shows and show him pool, so we got to be very good friends

ctx.x: But in the meantime he liked to play pool. I was a pool shark. I wasn't but 14 years old, I was a pool shark. I run the balls off like you take a whisk broom and brush them off, but this eat, that whole week, he was my turkey. They used to put up-I used to win it. So it got along the third day, he say, kid, -- no, I told him, I say, "I saw your show and it was marvelous," I say, "how did you do all them things? You fascinate me," which he did. He say, "kid, I tell you what, you teach me how to play pool like…

So every day for the remaining three days he was there, he would give me two or three hours of the fundamentals, and then I would take him between shows and show him pool, so we got to be very good friends, and heavy, man, he could sing -- this cat could sing like a mockingbird and he did all these things so effortless. He was a picture.
